resources.Resource:
JdbcDriver org.postgresql.Driver JdbcUrl jdbc:postgresql://${DB_HOST:-localhost}:${DB_PORT:-5432}/${DB_NAME:-app_db} UserName ${DB_USER:-postgres} Password ${DB_PASSWORD}
JtaManaged = true
InitialSize = 5 MinIdle = 5 MaxIdle = 10 MaxActive = 20 MaxWaitTime = 5 seconds
TestOnBorrow = true ValidationQuery = SELECT 1
